title: WPSS/377/2013 of RAJENDRA SINGH RAWAT and OTHERS Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT
NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 377 of 2013 (S/S)
Rajendra Singh Rawat & others ...Petitioners
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others
....Respondents
Mr. A.K.Bisht, Advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Subhash Upadhyay, Standing Counsel for the Sate.

1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The present petition has been moved by the petitioners
for direction to the respondents to pay arrears of salary to
the petitioners from the date of termination to the date of
their reinstatement alongwith 18 % interest and also grant
other consequential benefits. Further prayer has been made
for a direction to the respondents to decide the
representation of the petitioners.

2
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that on
31.07.2007 the service of the petitioners were terminated.
Services of other employees were also terminated in similar
manner. Petitioners as well as other similar situated
employees filed writ petition no. 1313 of 2007 before this
Court. Same was allowed and impugned termination orders
were quashed. Against the said order special appeal was
filed by the State, which was dismissed. The respondents
paid entire arrears of salary to one similarly situated
employee who was also party in the Writ Petition (S/S) No.
1313 of 2007 but salary to the petitioners has not been
released. The petitioners moved several representations
before the respondents for grant of arrears of their salary
from the date of termination till the date they were given
rejoining in the department but nothing has been done so far.
Therefore, the petitioners filed present writ petition before
this court.
4. During the pendency of present writ petition, the
respondents have made payment of arrears of salary to the
other similarly situated employees, but salary for the period
in question has not been paid the petitioners. This fact is
admitted to the respondents that salary of other similarly
situated employees has already been paid.
5. Since, the respondents have already paid the salary to
other employees for the period in question, the respondents
cannot take different stand in the matter of the petitioners.
Considering all these facts, I direct the respondents to make

3
payment of arrears of salary to the petitioners for the period
from the date of termination order till the date of their
reinstatement. Other consequential benefits will also be
given. Payment shall be made within four months from the
date of production of certified copy of order.
6. This disposes of the writ petition. All pending
applications stand disposed of.
 (V.K.Bist, J.)
24.10.2013
Nahid
